title: Laa laa's voice as some cave ambience
description: This resource pack replaces cave4 cave7 and cave8 with Laa laa's voice from slendytubbies
body:
This resource pack replaces cave4 cave8 and cave7 with laa laa's voice from slendytubbies making the mining experience feel like someone is watching you while you mine for your resources. you can also test it with /playsound minecraft:ambient.cave player (your username)

(you need to sort of gamble for to test it)
